dependencies.scope: pinned C sources compiled into early kernel; arena and budget contract smoke checks
pinned lifecycle runtime compiled and exercised with one bounded step
pinned health registry and CRC32 compiled and exercised
portable supervisor state machine only; no board BSP or MMIO invoked
user-space compiler, IDE, language runtime and workflow tooling
portable diagnostic evidence and report schemas only
manifest and capability catalog integration; no arbitrary execution
separate Android HOME application using future authenticated NUN bridge

boundaries: Kernel is x86-64 only in this foundation; other processor families require separate ports.
Python, Windows GUI and web control-plane code remain in user space.
Fortran, Pascal and Delphi runtimes must never unwind exceptions through kernel frames.
Repository manifests are data and cannot cause dynamic code loading.
CRC32 detects accidental corruption and is not cryptographic authentication.
ReaperCripple hardware profiles require exact board qualification before hardware access.
The initial physical allocator is monotonic and does not reclaim pages.

verification.host_tests: make check covers the NUN physical page allocator; make kernel compiles the pinned native service sources.
